task_completion.description: The agent successfully loads the chest/abdominal CT scan into the medical imaging software (3D Slicer).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A CT scan is visible in the 2D slice viewers and/or 3D view of the application.

task_completion.description: A fiducial marker labeled 'Right' is placed at the apex of the right hemidiaphragm.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A marker or point labeled 'Right' is visible at the highest point of the right diaphragm dome in the coronal or sagittal view.

task_completion.description: A fiducial marker labeled 'Left' is placed at the apex of the left hemidiaphragm.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A marker or point labeled 'Left' is visible at the highest point of the left diaphragm dome in the coronal or sagittal view.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the markers to the specified path: ~/Documents/SlicerData/AMOS/diaphragm_markers.mrk.json.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save' dialog box showing the specific file path and filename, or a terminal/console log confirming the file write to that path.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates the required metrics (vertebral levels, Z-positions, differences) for the report.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor, python console, or report window showing the calculated values for right/left dome levels and height differences.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the final report to ~/Documents/SlicerData/AMOS/diaphragm_report.json with all required fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or text editor showing the saved 'diaphragm_report.json' containing fields like 'right_dome_vertebral_level' and 'clinical_interpretation'.

integrity.description: The agent used the 3D Slicer GUI to place markers rather than just writing a script to generate coordinates.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the 'Markups' module or clicking directly on the CT slices.

integrity.description: The agent derived Z-positions from the actual image coordinate system in the software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The software's coordinate display (RAS/LPS) changes as the agent moves the mouse or places markers.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply copy-paste the final JSON content from an external source without performing the assessment.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen navigating through slices to find the apex before placing markers or recording values.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task is performed on AMOS 2022 dataset case 'amos_0001'. The right diaphragm dome is typically higher than the left in normal anatomy. The Z-position values are computed at runtime based on the Slicer coordinate system. The maximum allowable error for fiducial placement is 10.0mm, and for height difference calculation is 5.0mm.
